$comment: Generator defaults for the 2019-2020 DTM, merged over bases/dtm-era4/gen.json (tools/layers.py gen_config). Only the engines, weights and chassis names differ from era 4: the rules, car profiles and the Hankook tyre carry over. Engine power and mass are first estimates, not calibrated.

chassis.$comment: Each make's real car per year of the era.

engines.$comment: 2.0 litre turbo four-cylinders, about 610 hp plus push-to-pass. mass_kg plus the car's mass_kg gives the 1,070 kg minimum with driver and fuel. passby_audio stays the era4 choice until turbo sounds exist.
